headline: Confirm where and when every title can launch without handing rights approval to a machine
capabilities: Confirm where, when, and on which platforms each title can launch
Cite the exact contract clause behind every clearance answer
Flag holdbacks that block earlier launch dates
Show which approvals are still needed before launch
outcomes: Confirmed launch dates with the contract terms cited
Caught holdbacks before they became launch problems
Freed rights teams to focus on deals, not lookups
why_try: The demo lets a programming manager ask a natural question about a title and receive a clearance answer with the contract clause cited, with the rights-approval boundary visible in the response.

sample_prompts.label: Programming Manager: Launch clearance
sample_prompts.prompt: Can we put Silver Harbor on our streaming service in the UK, and which contract clause says so?

sample_prompts.label: Distribution Lead: Distribution window and holdback
sample_prompts.prompt: Programming wants Paper Lantern live in Canada in about a month. Is there a holdback that blocks that date?

sample_prompts.label: Rights & Clearances Lead: Approval readiness draft
sample_prompts.prompt: Is Northern Signal ready to come to the rights team for sign-off? What is still missing?

business_flow: Programming managers, distribution leads, and rights teams
Approved contract files in Microsoft SharePoint
Distribution windows and rights approval status
